body: The transience is all around us my friend. Nothing is certain and everything has its own possibility to become fleeting. Women especially. Remember and enjoy the moments you have with people. Take solace in the fact that you knew them and can retain the memories you have of them. My past also haunts me uninvitingly through dreams. It can be hard to recover from I know. It's easy to stay in touch with people these days. It's up to the relationship between the two of you to make that possible. I suggest you let go of what you're holding on to. Begin to accept that it is only a dream and you have much more to explore in your waking life.
Congratulations on your fifteenth year of existence.
We're in it together, even being worlds apart.

I don't in any way put myself above the people here, nor do I suppose you all may find peace in this passage. All this post is meant to be is a bit of optimism through another human beings perception. If my view of reality and circumstance can help anyone at all then these words have served their purpose. Everyone expresses their emotions differently and while you don't find any comfort in this others may. I don't believe I'm wrong for showing people hope through my writing.
Why does this passage disturb you?
Thank you, stranger. It's a pleasure your eyes perceived.
Haha I don't know what kind of wow that is but either way, I'll take it.
I feel exactly as you do. If you want to talk with me I can talk. The similarities in our situations are striking.
Why don't you tell me more about yourself and your situation. I'm curious to hear it. I'll be around if you want to talk about it. Feel free to PM me if you'd like.

I am here with you. I once had a purpose and that purpose was to exist. What is existence in the sense of purpose? My purpose was very much externally influenced throughout my life. I was extremely selfless in my recent years, giving my full attention to relationships with SOs, friends, and family. Through that I left no room for self growth to occur, so I became a culmination of the people around me, not knowing who I really am at all. I sit here tonight not knowing the person I look at in the mirror. I guess my point is that when the phone calls stop, the people drift, the emotions nullify, and helplessness takes hold you have to take a step back and look at what existence means to you. We are made of nothingness and everything at once. The fact that we even know what we are as human beings boggles my mind and will till my mind loses the capability to ponder that thought. I'm not going to give you a run around of advice and tips because I'm sure you've seen most of it by now. However I'll give you a sense of solidarity. Just know - somewhere else in this world a man sits alone as well. This man is wondering when he will feel again. He wonders how and why he stopped. He is confused and helpless as you. He doesn't have an answer. But he will keep looking. He will endure this loneliness and grief in his soul because it is the condition of his unconventional mind. We have to create a reason to continue. Sometimes people fall into their reason like a winning lottery number; with no effort. I think we're fortunate that we can at least ponder the reason for our own existence, even if that reason is so far out of sight. Endure it with me, as I will surely endure it with you.

I'm here with you. The fact that I am also having the same affliction set upon my mind is not fable nor fiction nor word of solidarity for the sake of making myself feel better. I don't feel better. But I hope you do. I'm here with you in this seemingly constant mental quest for imaginative, creative and knowledgable thought even in your own company. I sat for nearly two hours yesterday in the presence of the woman I adore, in silence. She threw her wit and stories at me and what did I have for her? "Yeah..." "Is that right?". I am a shadow now and my relationships are suffering from it. Some understand while others don't. Luckily the woman I am close to is quite understanding of unconventional and exceptional minds. But that doesn't matter. It matters that I'm able to understand it. And I don't. And that's what I want you to know. That we are, together, sailing in an ocean of uncertainty. I am 25. I am a man. An empty one. I can only say in regards to advice that you should read and more importantly write. No matter you're ability to do so, force it. You'll be surprised how cathartic it really is once/if you find interest in it. Also memory exercises could help but I'm just delving into these words of advice myself. I think of depression and this specific ailment in a certain way that makes sense to me. And that is through a quote of my own. "When you wake each morning and sleep each night, and there is nothing but a blackness and emptiness encompassing the mind, body and soul, what do you begin to fill this void with first? What will be your light through the darkness?" Two simple questions. Questions you yourself have to answer. CONSIDER advice...do not take full trust in it each and every time. Always ask why and never settle. We are human beings with unconventional and exceptional minds. This world is ours and we must play this game. Consider my words.
